item.text: The current numeric evaluator parses every constraint value as a single float, so list operators need their own path before that parse. I’ll also handle list operators before the string evaluator’s empty-value check so a list can match `""`.

I’ve added the operator maps, evaluator branches, and request validation. Go’s JSON decoder accepts `null` inside a typed slice as a zero value, so the validation also checks for null elements to enforce the requested item types.
